content.title: Close the security modal with Escape
content.test_md_blob:
# Close the security modal with Escape

> Prove the open security modal closes when Escape is used.

## Step 1

Open {{dashboard_url}} and wait until the dashboard page with the Top Holdings card is fully visible.

## Step 2

In the Top Holdings card, explicitly activate the NVDA ticker, open its security preview popover, and activate OPEN SECURITY so the security modal is visible.

## Step 3

Capture baseline: the security modal is open on the dashboard.

## Step 4

With focus still on the open security modal, use Escape to dismiss it.

## Step 5

Assert that the security modal is no longer visible on the page.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-61, ac-63

Confirm state-transition check: security modal closed (equals) — the stated promise: The security modal closes when Escape is used.
